name: primitives-texts-highlight

frames.best_why: Both phrases are fully filled with their gradients, so the finished highlight state is clearest here.

tagline: Two phrases in a headline fill with colour behind their words.
summary: A three-line headline where two phrases get coloured highlight blocks that sweep in from the left, one after the other, over a couple of seconds.
appearance: A centred three-line headline in white on black. Two phrases sit inside rounded colour blocks: indigo to violet behind the first, and sky blue to cyan behind the second.
behaviour: Each highlight grows from zero to full width behind its phrase, left to right, with the second starting later. A Replay button clears both and runs the sweep again.
demo_content: The headline Build stunning interfaces with smooth, composable motion primitives and a Replay button.
search_phrases: headline where words get filled in
use_when: A hero headline should call out two key phrases as it scrolls into view.
avoid_when: The highlight colours are fixed in demo classes, and long highlighted phrases wrap awkwardly.
customise: Pass the phrase as text, and set delay, transition and in-view options; the highlight colour and rounding come from your own background classes.
weight_why: One span animating its background size; idle before it enters view.

a11y.note: The sweep starts on view with no reduced-motion check, though the highlighted words stay readable because the text colour is set by you.

issues: The Replay button is tiny and low contrast in the bottom-right corner.
polish_why: Crisp headline and a pleasing left-to-right fill; the tiny Replay control is the weak spot.
